items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Retail investors who try to beat the market by buying individual stocks or complex ETFs may not be more skilled than they were 30 years ago. French riots caused bond yields to reach a 24-year high as investors evaluate risks from budget policies, economic growth, and sector stability. Most executives think about AI costs in terms of powerful GPUs and silicon shortages, but they often forget about data storage expenses. A scalable AI system needs many parts working together, like data, engineering, and governance.
